output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-9101c3082071] is just a metric name. The section it sits in [ev-1f419676f177] explains what it means. In Loki 3.0.0, metrics prefixed `cortex_`, including this one, are renamed to start with `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is now `loki`. Operators who want to keep the `cortex_` name must set `metrics_namespace: cortex`, and that setting is deprecated and due for removal in the next minor release. So the subject is this metric, the change is a rename to `loki_prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds`, exposure is any setup still on the default namespace, and the consequence is that the `cortex_` name stops being emitted unless the operator overrides the namespace.
